name: Sable Fix Core 1.6.0
body:
## v1.6.0 — Watch page & path hardening

- 📊 **Ticket stats**: tickets are now aggregated per UUID — total vs unique counts at the top, per-UUID ticket counts on each row, duplicates highlighted in amber (a UUID holding many tickets is the classic stuck-chunk signal)
- 🧭 **Deadlock watch page scrolls** when the UUID list is long
- 📁 **CWD-independent paths**: thread dumps resolve against the JVM user.dir (game run directory) instead of the process working directory — dumps land in the right logs/sablefix/ even when the server is started through wrappers/launchers that change CWD

## 中文
- 📊 **票据统计**：按 UUID 聚合 — 顶部显示总条数/唯一数，每行显示该 UUID 持有的票据数，重复项琥珀色高亮（一个 UUID 抓一堆票据 = 经典的区块卡死信号）
- 🧭 死锁监视页 UUID 列表过长时可滚动
- 📁 **路径与 CWD 解耦**：线程栈转储按 JVM user.dir（游戏运行目录）解析 — 用启动器/包装脚本改了工作目录启动服务器也能正确落盘到 logs/sablefix/
